GDX residual-reversal strategy — in-sample report

Summary

Status: hard_filters_disabled. Hard filters were disabled for this run: the shortlist is the top configs by neighbourhood score and the primary is the best by validation Sharpe + neighbourhood rank. Filter results are shown for information only; the primary fails f_months, f_halves, f_years, f_ex_top_days on validation, so it does not meet every stated requirement (e.g. at least one trade per month).

Primary: GLD|L250|m1|k1.25|H1|A|rev   alternates: IAU|L250|m1|k1|H1|A|rev, IAU|L250|m1|k1.25|H1|A|rev

  • Development net Sharpe 0.08 (neighbourhood median 0.73); validation net Sharpe -0.13. Validation failed filters: f_months, f_halves, f_years, f_ex_top_days.
  • Model: two_stage — All-combinations exploration (no GDXJ, original 2008 window), specified after validation was seen; validation results are a logged deviation, judge on OOS only. Hard filters disabled at the user's request (reported, not applied)..
  • Deflated Sharpe ratio (N = 54,000 configs tried on this data): 0.000; placebo percentile 70.1; sign-flip Sharpe -0.22; bootstrap 95% CI [-0.47, 0.62].
  • Walk-forward of the selection rule 2011–2021: stitched net Sharpe 0.22, 8 distinct configs in 11 years (red flag: True).

All returns are daily GDX excess returns on 1x notional (self-financing overlay), net of 2 bps per unit traded unless stated. Signals are formed and executed at the close of day t. Development 2008-05-27 → 2016-12-30, validation 2017-01-03 → 2021-12-31.

Is the edge concentrated on day 1?

At the primary's k=1.25: cumulative edge after day 1 is +7.9 bps (dev) / -3.5 bps (val); after day 2 +61.3 / +23.3 bps; after day 10 +55.7 / +26.8 bps. The day-1 concentration hypothesis is not supported: the edge is small on day 1 and peaks around day 2 in development, then decays.
